author.name: Requirements Reuben
author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Override Blind Spot
challenge.description: Store managers are overriding order suggestions at an alarming rate because they cannot verify if the model behind them is the one they tested. #model_monica# wants a fully automated registry to ensure every deployment is traceable and reproducible. #requirements_reuben# has a red line: no model enters the registry without a manual, documented review of its evaluation metrics to ensure compliance, so he insists on keeping the process manual.

output.content: I am drawing a firm line here regarding the deployment pipeline. No model enters the registry without a manual, documented review of its evaluation metrics. I will not accept an automated check that bypasses this step, as it fails to guarantee the compliance standards we require for our production systems. The registry must remain a controlled gate where a human architect validates the evidence before any version is marked as ready. This is not a preference for slower workflows. It is a hard requirement to ensure that every model serving our store managers has been rigorously tested against our data governance rules. I refuse to sign off on any architecture that removes this manual verification step from the critical path.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly refuses to accept automated checks that bypass manual review and defines this manual verification as a hard requirement, establishing a non-negotiable limit on the deployment pipeline.
